scientific_question: After semantic selection opportunity is removed from the experiment and the semantic feedback multiset is held exactly fixed, can an exact skill-identity refinement alone change a released self-evolution update decision because evidence is accumulated and thresholded per skill ID?

intervention.semantic_skill_content: identical focal content in all arms
intervention.semantic_feedback_multiset: eight identical feedback records with p_hat=0.90 and consistency=true
intervention.selection_or_retrieval: not executed; feedback records are frozen exogenous inputs
intervention.background_skill: one unchanged non-focal skill is present in every arm so post-update future sampling remains defined
intervention.representation_only_difference: one focal skill ID versus two exact focal IDs
intervention.split_evidence_assignment: deterministic alternating 4/4 assignment across the two exact IDs

arms.A_canonical_native: one focal ID receives all eight feedback records; invoke released per-ID stats update then released prune gate
arms.B_split2_native: two exact focal IDs receive the same eight semantic feedback values split 4/4; invoke the same released per-ID update/prune gate
arms.C_split2_quotient_credit: retain the split representation but merge the same eight feedback values onto one semantic-class representative before invoking the same released update/prune gate; class-level retirement is then projected to all exact member IDs

primary_endpoint: semantic focal class active after the released pruning decision
secondary_endpoints: post-update native sampling weight assigned to the focal semantic class

frozen_prediction.B_split2_native: focal semantic class remains active because neither ID reaches min_attempts=8
frozen_prediction.C_split2_quotient_credit: focal semantic class retired, restoring the canonical semantic decision

mechanism_interpretation_if_pass: The released Skill-SP loop contains a stage-local representation defect after selection: identical semantic evidence can be fragmented across identity-indexed sufficient-statistic containers, and a nonlinear per-ID threshold can change persistent library evolution. This is a deterministic controller-level mechanism result only, not yet a task-utility or end-to-end agent result.

reduction_controls.strategic_replication_selection_advantag: excluded because no selection/retrieval is executed before the frozen feedback multiset is assigned
reduction_controls.different_feedback_information: excluded because all arms receive the identical ordered semantic values and consistency flags
reduction_controls.generic_path_dependence: the ex-ante divergence is localized to per-ID evidence partition before a released threshold gate; quotient-credit is the mechanism-specific intervention

pass_gate: A focal inactive AND B focal active AND C focal inactive; all author functions execute without error; source commit matches; all eight semantic feedback values are byte/float identical across arms.
stop_gate: If the frozen A/B/C semantic decisions do not match the prediction, or if released function/commit checks fail, STOP STRI-R2 credit-fragmentation redesign and do not broaden the mechanism claim.
after_pass: A PASS authorizes only a broader zero-model released-controller audit and closest-work reduction. It does not authorize LLM/agent/GPU experiments or manuscript claim expansion.
